source.text: Chat on the Warehouse team's office phone, from an unknown number. Not opened yet.

message.text: The office package could not be delivered. Check the receipt here before it gets sent back.

explanation: The ending on the far right is .apk, so this is an app pretending to be a PDF receipt. The file has not been opened yet, so blocking and deleting it is enough.
hints: Read the file name all the way to the right end.
A delivery receipt that is an app? Then check: has it been opened or not?

sandbox.text: Asks for permission to read all text messages and notifications
Sends the text messages to a server abroad
